title: Du'a for Distress and Anxiety
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
latin: La ilaha illallahul 'azhimul haliim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbul 'arsyil 'azhim
translation: There is no god but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne.
lesson: When anxiety rises, this du'a grounds you. It magnifies Allah and shrinks the problem.
